Type: acceptance gate
Plan: docs/institutional-pilot-epics.md
Assessment: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: Q03
Accountable role (person unassigned): Institutional operator and service owner
Pilot scope: required

Outcome: An operator can own a bounded institutional beta and recover it without the original engineer or server.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A different operator installs/upgrades the packaged release, diagnoses an injected fault and restores onto replacement infrastructure using the documented independent backup/policy sources.
2. Revoke access and withdraw data after backup, then lose the original host; verify current restrictions, exact retained exports and coherent pending work after recovery; meet accepted RPO/RTO.
3. Verify real alert/escalation delivery and support responsibilities, record beta observation criteria and runbook results, and identify any conditional source/visualization gate. Production cutover requires a separate service-owner decision.

Review all child evidence against these integration criteria. Children closing does not automatically close this gate. Required human/institutional evidence must be observed, never inferred from automated tests.

Completion rule: satisfy every acceptance criterion with observed evidence. Failed or not-run requirements stay open. Preserve scientific identity/history and current authority; create blocking remediation work for discovered scope. Automated or simulated evidence cannot replace a required institutional or human result. No implementation is claimed by this plan.
